title: Leviticus Chapter 18 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Leviticus chapter 18 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Leviticus Chapter 18 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Leviticus Chapter 18.

questions.question: To whom did the LORD speak in Leviticus 18?
questions.correctAnswer: Moses
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:1 states that the LORD spake unto Moses.

questions.question: What name does God use to identify Himself to the children of Israel?
questions.correctAnswer: The LORD your God
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:2 says, 'I am the LORD your God.'

questions.question: According to Leviticus 18, whose practices are the children of Israel forbidden to follow?
questions.correctAnswer: Egypt and Canaan
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:3 forbids doing after the doings of the land of Egypt and Canaan.

questions.question: What are the children of Israel commanded to do instead of following the ordinances of Egypt and Canaan?
options: Do God's judgments and keep His ordinances
Follow the laws of other nations
questions.correctAnswer: Do God's judgments and keep His ordinances
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:4 commands them to do God's judgments and keep His ordinances.

questions.question: What promise is given to those who keep God's statutes and judgments?
options: They shall be free from sorrow
questions.correctAnswer: They shall live in them
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:5 promises that if a man keeps statutes and judgments, he shall live in them.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 18 commands that none should uncover the nakedness of any near kin.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:6 states that none shall approach any near kin to uncover their nakedness.

questions.question: Which of the following relatives' nakedness is one forbidden to uncover according to Leviticus 18?
questions.correctAnswer: Father's sister
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:12 forbids uncovering the nakedness of the father's sister.

questions.question: True or False: The command to not uncover the nakedness of the mother applies even if she is not your biological mother.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:7 specifically refers to 'thy mother', implying the biological mother, not a non-biological one.

questions.question: Who is described as 'thy father's nakedness' in Leviticus 18?
questions.correctAnswer: Thy father's wife
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:8 says the nakedness of thy father's wife is thy father's nakedness.

questions.question: Which relatives' nakedness must not be uncovered 'whether she be born at home, or born abroad'?
options: Thy sister, daughter of thy father or mother
questions.correctAnswer: Thy sister, daughter of thy father or mother
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:9 forbids uncovering the nakedness of thy sister, daughter of thy father or mother, whether born at home or abroad.

questions.question: True or False: You may uncover the nakedness of your son's daughter according to Leviticus 18.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:10 forbids uncovering the nakedness of thy son's daughter.

questions.question: What is the relationship of the woman described in Leviticus 18:11, whose nakedness you must not uncover?
options: Thy father's wife's daughter begotten of thy father
questions.correctAnswer: Thy father's wife's daughter begotten of thy father
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:11 says not to uncover the nakedness of thy father's wife's daughter begotten of thy father, who is thy sister.

questions.question: Which commandment comes first in Leviticus 18?
options: Do not uncover the nakedness of thy father
Do not walk in the ordinances of Egypt and Canaan
Do not lie with mankind as with womankind
questions.correctAnswer: Do not walk in the ordinances of Egypt and Canaan
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:3 instructs not to do after the doings of Egypt and Canaan before other specific commands.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 18, whose nakedness is forbidden to be uncovered because it is considered 'thy father's nakedness'?
questions.correctAnswer: Thy father's wife
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:8 identifies thy father's wife as thy father's nakedness, forbidding uncovering her nakedness.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 18 forbids uncovering the nakedness of thy brother's wife.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:16 states not to uncover the nakedness of thy brother's wife.

medium.title: Leviticus Chapter 18 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Leviticus Chapter 18 to real-life situations.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 18:11, what relation is the father's wife's daughter begotten of your father?
questions.correctAnswer: She is your sister
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:11 explicitly states that the father's wife's daughter, begotten of the father, is considered a sister and her nakedness must not be uncovered.

questions.question: What instruction does Leviticus 18:12 give regarding your father's sister?
options: You shall not uncover her nakedness
You shall honor her with gifts
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not uncover her nakedness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:12 commands that the nakedness of the father's sister must not be uncovered, recognizing her as a near kinswoman and prohibiting intimate relations.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 18:13 relate to family boundaries in terms of the mother's sister?
options: She is to be treated as a stranger
You shall not uncover her nakedness
You may marry her after your mother's death
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not uncover her nakedness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:13 instructs that the mother's sister is a near kinswoman and prohibits uncovering her nakedness, emphasizing respect for family boundaries.

questions.question: What does Leviticus 18:14 prohibit regarding your father's brother's wife?
options: You shall not speak ill of her
You shall not uncover her nakedness
You shall treat her as a sister
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not uncover her nakedness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:14 forbids uncovering the nakedness of your father's brother's wife, identifying her as your aunt and imposing a moral boundary.

questions.question: Based on Leviticus 18:15 and 18:16, how are relationships with a daughter-in-law and a brother's wife viewed?
options: They are considered permissible marriage partners
You shall not uncover their nakedness
You may approach them with consent
questions.correctAnswer: You shall not uncover their nakedness
questions.explanation: Verses 15 and 16 emphasize that both the daughter-in-law and the brother's wife are forbidden sexual partners, prohibiting uncovering their nakedness as a sign of respect and obedience to God's statutes.

questions.question: Leviticus 18:17 forbids uncovering the nakedness of a woman and her near kinswomen. What is the reason given for this prohibition?
questions.correctAnswer: It is wickedness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:17 explicitly states that uncovering the nakedness of a woman and her daughter or granddaughters is wickedness, underscoring the moral gravity of the sin.

questions.question: What does Leviticus 18:18 warn against regarding marrying sisters?
options: It is encouraged to strengthen family ties
It is forbidden to vex a wife by marrying her sister during her lifetime
It is allowed only after the first wife dies
It is mandated for inheritance purposes
questions.correctAnswer: It is forbidden to vex a wife by marrying her sister during her lifetime
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:18 forbids taking a wife to her sister to vex her by uncovering her nakedness alongside the other, emphasizing the importance of harmony and respect in marriage.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 18:19, when is it forbidden to approach a woman to uncover her nakedness?
options: When she is married to another
questions.correctAnswer: During her menstrual uncleanness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:19 prohibits sexual relations with a woman while she is set apart for her uncleanness, commonly understood as during menstruation, reflecting God's call for holiness and respect.

questions.question: What is forbidden in Leviticus 18:20 regarding a neighbor's wife?
questions.correctAnswer: To lie carnally with her
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:20 forbids lying carnally with a neighbor's wife, warning against defiling oneself with her and promoting faithfulness and integrity in relationships.

questions.question: What consequence does Leviticus 18:29 say will happen to those who commit any of the abominations listed in the chapter?
options: They will be forgiven if they repent
They shall be cut off from among their people
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be cut off from among their people
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:29 declares that anyone committing these abominations will be cut off from their people, indicating a severe spiritual and communal consequence for disobedience.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 18:21 allows the passing of your seed through the fire to Molech.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:21 explicitly forbids letting any of your seed pass through the fire to Molech, warning not to profane God's name.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 18:22 states that lying with mankind as with womankind is an abomination.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:22 clearly states that lying with mankind as with womankind is an abomination, defining it as morally unacceptable.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 18:19 permits approaching a woman during her uncleanness if she consents.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:19 forbids approaching a woman to uncover her nakedness as long as she is set apart for her uncleanness, regardless of consent, emphasizing obedience to God's law.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 18:26 connect the behavior of the Israelites to the previous inhabitants of the land?
options: Israelites are encouraged to imitate the nations
Israelites must avoid committing the abominations done by the men of the land
Israelites may adopt some customs of the strangers
Israelites should forget the previous nations' sins
questions.correctAnswer: Israelites must avoid committing the abominations done by the men of the land
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:26 commands the Israelites to keep God's statutes and not commit the abominations that the men of the land before them had done, emphasizing faithfulness and holiness.

questions.question: What does Leviticus 18:27 say about the abominations committed by the men of the land?
options: They were unknown to the Israelites
questions.correctAnswer: They defiled the land
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:27 notes that the abominations committed by the men of the land defiled the land, providing context for God's judgment and instructions to Israel.

hard.title: Leviticus Chapter 18 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Leviticus Chapter 18.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 18, what is the consequence for those who commit any of the abominations listed in the chapter?
options: They shall be cut off from among their people
They shall be forgiven after repentance
They shall be exiled for seven years
They shall be fined by the community
questions.correctAnswer: They shall be cut off from among their people
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:29 states that whoever commits any of these abominations shall have their souls cut off from among their people, indicating severe communal exclusion.

questions.question: Which pagan practice is explicitly forbidden in Leviticus 18:21?
options: Letting any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech
questions.correctAnswer: Letting any of thy seed pass through the fire to Molech
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:21 forbids letting any of one's seed pass through the fire to Molech, a pagan ritual, and warns against profaning God's name by such acts.

questions.question: What is described as 'abomination' in Leviticus 18:22?
options: Lying with mankind as with womankind
questions.correctAnswer: Lying with mankind as with womankind
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:22 explicitly calls lying with mankind as with womankind an abomination, indicating a prohibition of homosexual acts.

questions.question: Leviticus 18:23 prohibits lying with which creatures?
questions.correctAnswer: Beasts
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:23 forbids lying with any beast and states that neither shall a woman stand before a beast to lie down thereto, describing such acts as confusion.

questions.question: What literary device is used in Leviticus 18:24-30 to emphasize the holiness expected from Israel compared to the defilement of surrounding nations?
questions.correctAnswer: Inclusio framing
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:24-30 uses inclusio, beginning and ending with warnings against defilement and commands to keep God's statutes, framing the entire passage and emphasizing Israel's call to holiness.

questions.question: What does the Hebrew word for 'abomination' (תּוֹעֵבָה, to'evah) as used in Leviticus 18 convey about the nature of the prohibited acts?
options: They are detestable and morally repugnant acts
questions.correctAnswer: They are detestable and morally repugnant acts
questions.explanation: The Hebrew word תּוֹעֵבָה (to'evah) used in Leviticus 18 conveys that the acts are abominable, detestable, and morally repugnant to God, emphasizing the severity of these prohibitions.

questions.question: Which New Testament passage echoes the prohibition of sexual immorality as found in Leviticus 18?
questions.correctAnswer: 1 Corinthians 6:9-10
questions.explanation: 1 Corinthians 6:9-10 echoes the prohibitions against sexual immorality found in Leviticus 18, warning that such behaviors prevent inheriting the kingdom of God.

questions.question: Leviticus 18:26 commands Israel not to commit the abominations. Who else does this command extend to?
options: Neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you
questions.correctAnswer: Neither any of your own nation, nor any stranger that sojourneth among you
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:26 explicitly includes both Israelites and any strangers living among them in the command not to commit these abominations, showing the inclusiveness of the law.

questions.question: According to Leviticus 18:25, what is the result when a land is defiled by iniquity?
options: The land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants
The land becomes fertile and productive
The land is blessed with peace
The land is given to another nation
questions.correctAnswer: The land itself vomiteth out her inhabitants
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:25 states that when a land is defiled by iniquity, God visits the iniquity upon it and the land vomits out its inhabitants, indicating divine judgment.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 18:28 warns that if Israel defiles the land, God will spue them out as He did the nations before them.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:28 clearly warns that the land will spue out Israel if they defile it, just as it did with the nations before them, indicating the seriousness of obedience.

questions.question: Which relationship is NOT specifically forbidden to uncover nakedness in Leviticus 18?
questions.correctAnswer: Cousin's wife
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18 lists many forbidden relations including father's brother's wife (verse 14), mother's sister (verse 13), and son's wife (verse 15), but cousin's wife is not mentioned.

questions.question: What is the significance of the phrase 'I am the LORD your God' repeated in Leviticus 18?
options: It serves as a covenant reminder of God's authority and identity
It is a poetic device with no theological meaning
It refers to the people’s kingship
It is a historical note about Moses
questions.correctAnswer: It serves as a covenant reminder of God's authority and identity
questions.explanation: The repeated phrase 'I am the LORD your God' in Leviticus 18 underscores God's covenant relationship, asserting His authority to command and judge the people.

questions.question: True or False: Leviticus 18:18 forbids taking a wife and her sister as wives at the same time to vex her.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:18 forbids marrying a wife and her sister simultaneously as it causes vexation, reflecting concern for familial harmony.

questions.question: Leviticus 18:20 forbids lying carnally with whose wife?
questions.correctAnswer: Thy neighbour's wife
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:20 prohibits lying carnally with thy neighbour's wife, emphasizing respect for another man's marriage.

questions.question: Which aspect of Leviticus 18 reflects a concern for social purity and separation from surrounding nations?
options: Commands not to follow Egyptian or Canaanite customs
questions.correctAnswer: Commands not to follow Egyptian or Canaanite customs
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:3 warns Israel not to follow the customs of Egypt or Canaan, highlighting social and religious separation from pagan nations.

theological.title: Leviticus Chapter 18 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Leviticus Chapter 18 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What fundamental reason does Leviticus 18:5 give for keeping God's statutes and judgments?
options: So that a man may live in them
To be respected by the nations
questions.correctAnswer: So that a man may live in them
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:5 states that keeping God's statutes and judgments results in life, emphasizing obedience as the path to true life rather than mere external benefits.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is primarily revealed in God's prohibition against uncovering the nakedness of close kin as stated in Leviticus 18:6?
questions.correctAnswer: Holiness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:6 reflects God's holiness, setting moral boundaries that separate His people from sinful practices, demonstrating His pure and distinct nature.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 18:21 connect to the doctrine of worship and idolatry?
options: It forbids child sacrifice to Molech, protecting the sanctity of worship to the LORD
It commands worship of Molech alongside the LORD
It permits offering sacrifices to any deity
It encourages passing children through fire as a test of faith
questions.correctAnswer: It forbids child sacrifice to Molech, protecting the sanctity of worship to the LORD
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:21 forbids child sacrifice to Molech, emphasizing exclusive worship of the LORD and condemning idolatrous practices that profane God's name.

questions.question: What combined teaching do Leviticus 18:3 and Leviticus 18:4 convey about Israel's relationship to the surrounding nations?
options: Israel must not follow the practices of Egypt and Canaan but keep God's judgments to walk in His ways
Israel should adopt the customs of Egypt and Canaan to blend in
God allows Israel to walk in the ordinances of the land they dwell in
Israel is free to choose any customs without consequence
questions.correctAnswer: Israel must not follow the practices of Egypt and Canaan but keep God's judgments to walk in His ways
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:3 commands Israel to reject the immoral practices of Egypt and Canaan, while 18:4 calls them to keep God's judgments, highlighting their distinct covenantal identity and sanctification.

questions.question: Which doctrine is most clearly taught by the repeated prohibitions against sexual relations with relatives throughout Leviticus 18:6-17?
options: The doctrine of sanctification through purity
The doctrine of justification by faith
questions.correctAnswer: The doctrine of sanctification through purity
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:6-17 outlines prohibitions to maintain sexual purity, teaching sanctification as God's call for His people to be holy and set apart from defilement.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 18:22 reveal God's standard for human sexuality and moral order?
options: It declares male homosexual acts as an abomination, affirming a created sexual order
It permits all sexual relations without restriction
It allows male same-sex relations but forbids female
It is silent on sexual ethics
questions.correctAnswer: It declares male homosexual acts as an abomination, affirming a created sexual order
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:22 explicitly forbids male homosexual acts, underscoring God's intention for sexual relations within His created order between male and female.

questions.question: What theological insight is gained by synthesizing Leviticus 18:24-25 about the consequences of defilement?
options: The land itself becomes defiled and can 'vomit out' its inhabitants due to sin
Defilement has no impact on the land or people
Only individuals suffer consequences, not the land
God ignores the moral condition of the land
questions.correctAnswer: The land itself becomes defiled and can 'vomit out' its inhabitants due to sin
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:24-25 teaches that sin defiles not only individuals but the land itself, resulting in divine judgment where the land 'vomits out' its inhabitants, showing God's justice over creation.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 18:28 relate to the broader redemptive narrative concerning obedience and judgment?
options: It warns Israel to avoid defiling the land lest they be rejected like previous nations
It promises unconditional blessing regardless of obedience
It encourages Israel to imitate the nations' sinful ways
It states that judgment is irrelevant to obedience
questions.correctAnswer: It warns Israel to avoid defiling the land lest they be rejected like previous nations
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:28 connects obedience to covenant blessings and warns that defilement leads to judgment, emphasizing a theme of God's justice throughout salvation history.

questions.question: What theological principle about God's moral law emerges from combining Leviticus 18:26 and Leviticus 18:30?
options: All people in the community, native or stranger, are bound to keep God's ordinances to avoid defilement
Only native Israelites must keep the laws, strangers are exempt
God's laws apply only to temple priests
Moral laws are optional based on personal preference
questions.correctAnswer: All people in the community, native or stranger, are bound to keep God's ordinances to avoid defilement
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:26 and 18:30 stress that both Israelites and sojourners must obey God's statutes to prevent defilement, underscoring the universal scope of covenant obedience.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that prohibitions in Leviticus 18 are merely cultural and irrelevant today. What does Leviticus 18:29-30 actually teach about the seriousness of these commandments?
options: Those who commit these abominations shall be cut off from their people, showing God's enduring moral standards
These laws were only for ancient times and have no consequences today
It permits selective observance of laws
questions.correctAnswer: Those who commit these abominations shall be cut off from their people, showing God's enduring moral standards
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:29-30 declares severe consequences for violating these commandments, demonstrating God's holy and unchanging standards rather than mere cultural customs.

questions.question: From Leviticus 18:18, what principle about marital relationships and God's design is revealed?
options: Taking a wife and her sister simultaneously is forbidden to prevent vexation
A man may marry sisters at the same time without issue
questions.correctAnswer: Taking a wife and her sister simultaneously is forbidden to prevent vexation
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:18 forbids marrying a woman and her sister concurrently to avoid causing distress, revealing God's concern for harmony in marriage.

questions.question: Which attribute of God does Leviticus 18:1-2 especially emphasize by declaring 'I am the LORD your God' before giving commandments?
questions.correctAnswer: Authority and covenantal relationship
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:1-2 stress God's sovereign authority and His covenant relationship with Israel by prefacing commands with His self-identification as their LORD and God.

questions.question: How does Leviticus 18:19 contribute to the doctrine of ritual purity and sanctification?
options: It prohibits sexual relations with a woman during her menstrual uncleanness, emphasizing ritual holiness
It permits sexual relations at any time
It forbids all sexual relations permanently
It allows uncleanness to be ignored
questions.correctAnswer: It prohibits sexual relations with a woman during her menstrual uncleanness, emphasizing ritual holiness
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:19 forbids approaching a woman during her uncleanness, highlighting God's demand for ritual purity as part of sanctification.

questions.question: What broader redemptive significance does Leviticus 18:20 have in the context of covenant faithfulness?
options: It forbids lying with a neighbor's wife, reinforcing faithfulness and covenant loyalty
It permits adultery under certain conditions
It is unrelated to covenant ethics
questions.correctAnswer: It forbids lying with a neighbor's wife, reinforcing faithfulness and covenant loyalty
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:20 prohibits sexual relations with a neighbor's wife, symbolizing the faithfulness required in covenant relationships and God's holiness.

questions.question: What doctrinal truth is highlighted by the connection of Leviticus 18:9 and 18:10 regarding the prohibition of uncovering nakedness of close family members?
options: The sanctity of family relations and the call to purity within the covenant community
The acceptance of all sexual relations
questions.correctAnswer: The sanctity of family relations and the call to purity within the covenant community
questions.explanation: Leviticus 18:9 and 18:10 prohibit sexual relations with siblings and grandchildren, underscoring the sacredness of family and purity required by God's covenant.
